materiality.rationale: Pinned target architecture makes privacy a gating constraint and exposes selective-disclosure, unlinkability, relationship, verifier, status/policy and Trust Task correlation surfaces.

risk.reason: Documented partial durable-audit coverage creates bounded residual risk without proving whole-target failure.

harm.reason: Accountability/redress harm is plausible from audit gaps but no fresh harm-realization scenario was demonstrated.

security.reason: Target documents high-severity unaudited state mutations and silent audit-write failures; evidence is bounded, not a whole-target security FAIL.

composition.reason: Composition positive control, context-distinct no-join case and falsification vector executed coherently; evidence remains composition-attributed.

privacy.reason: Fresh DPIP #135 concluded evidence-classification-required because the Dogwood-native same-DID run is semantically mis-typed as an unlinkability-pressure case.

terminal.why_not_green: Documented audit residuals remain and Dogwood-native privacy experiment-role metadata prevents a target-level privacy PASS.
terminal.why_not_red: The fresh run did not establish target-created cross-context correlation or a whole-target security/privacy failure; composition pressure evidence is bounded favourable.
terminal.recommended_next_step: Fix Interop Lab #69, then create a new comparable pinned Dogwood privacy examination with correctly separated positive-control and context-distinct native experiments; do not mutate DPIP #135 or RAHP #248.
